scope: Nine real image-batch fill/tiling workloads frozen before benchmark generation or calls; retain every gain and loss. No whole-library ownership claim.
independent_oracle: Pack converted scalar/vector fill into a bytearray and overwrite image row spans at independently computed padded grid offsets. For the one float64 mean case, input values are exact small integers; use integer sums and Fraction-to-float for the exact rounded channel fill. No montage call or NumPy tile assignment in the oracle.
timed_boundary: Whole public montage call, including decorator/prelude, mean provider where selected, fresh allocation, typed fill, tile copying, temporary allocations and output destruction. Input fixture generation, independent oracle and admission/parity guards remain outside timing.
provider_frontier: Axis/asarray/grid/fill conversions and mean remain explicit providers. Rescale is not included in these timed workloads. Native credit requires actual montage_apply builtin C-return and frontend native_result=True, with original whole-montage forwarding trapped.
generation: Seeded small nonnegative integer words cast to the actual dtype; genuine grayscale/color batches. Strided case uses an oversized owner sliced/reversed without materialization; Fortran and channels-first cases preserve their advertised layout.
